content.query:
SELECT 
OTD.TASK_NAME,OT.FREQUENCY_LOADING,OTR.PROCESS_DATE,OTR.STATUS_ID
FROM OM.OM_TASK_DEPENDENCY OTD
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASK_RUN OTR
ON OTD.TASK_NAME=OTR.TASK_NAME
AND PROCESS_DATE in ('2023-10-13','2023-10-15')
LEFT JOIN OM.OM_TASKS OT
ON OTD.TASK_NAME=OT.TASK_NAME
WHERE 
DEPENDENT_TASK_NAME='TSK_EDS_CUSTOMER_DIM'


select DISTINCT FREQUENCY_LOADING from om.om_Tasks
